title: HYDRATING Toner
body:
HYDRATION is key! I bought this toner because I felt that I had a damaged skin barrier and wanted to restore my skin. I have oily dehydrated skin at the moment, and no amount of moisturizer will keep my oils at bay. I was looking for a hydrating toner that contained Ceramides or Panthenol. This toner not only checked those boxes but also contains Hyaluronic acid (hydration) and Centella Asiatica (soothing effect)! I also like how the ingredient list is not excessively long compared to other formulas.

I have some rosacea spots on my skin and this toner did not sting my cheeks at all, but left my skin plump and hydrated! When I moved my facial muscles, I used to feel a tightness in my skin despite my skin being oily. After using this toner, I no longer feel the tightness in my skin and see less oil production. (I've also been using Krave Beauty products with this, just FYI.) I use the toner in the AM and PM and put 3-4 layers of the toner each time to rescue my skin barrier.

Knowing TonyMoly's brand for a few years now, its cute packaging made me skeptical that this toner would do "wonders". Yet lo and behold, I can see this toner being a staple for a while. I live in a desert area near the beach, and this toner has provided me with great hydration. I also see this toner being effective in the winter months when my skin gets even drier. Also, the price point for 500 mL is such a great steal in my opinion!

There is a slight scent, but I really enjoy the fresh, citrus/lemon scent and the smell dissipates quickly. I usually avoid heavily fragranced products, but I had no problems with the scent of this toner. The toner is milky and viscous, but the formula is runny like a liquid and adds to the hydration component this toner offers. Since I currently apply 3-4 layers of this toner at a time due to my damaged skin barrier, I can't say that this toner will sink into your skin immediately after one layer. However, it has helped all my other skincare products absorb better.

When I initially bought it off Amazon, I was skeptical that this toner was not really from TonyMoly.
